title: Tech N9ne & E-40 Plot Co-Headlining 2026 Strange Wid’ It Tour: See the Dates
summary: The "Zombie" collaborators' trek kicks off in Nebraska in April.
contentText:
Tech N9ne and E-40 are reuniting to hit the road together for a co-headlining trek this spring. The Strange Wid’ It Tour will take flight in Nebraska on April 12 and make stops across the U.S. into May.

General admission tickets and VIP packages are currently available for all 27 dates through the Strange Music website and Ticketmaster.

Nebraska rapper King Iso, who’s signed to Tech’s Strange Music label, is set to serve as an opener on the tour. Cities on the run include Milwaukee, Dallas, Denver, Salt Lake City, Anaheim, TGreen Bay, Nashville, St. Louis, Tech’s hometown of Kansas City and more.

E-40 and Tech N9ne aren’t strangers to one another, as they’ve teamed up for tours in the past, as well as joining forces on tracks such as the Bay Area native’s “Zombie” and Tech’s “No K.”

Tech unleashed his 5816 Forest album in June, which featured him sparring with the legendary Lil Wayne on “Yoda.” As for 40 Water, the “Tell Me When to Go” rapper returned at the top of 2026 while lending an assist to Chef Boy’s “Pesos.”

Find all of the Strange Wid’ It Tour dates below.
